strings.name: Alain Aspect
strings.summary: Alain Aspect tested Bell inequalities with entangled photons, turning disagreements between quantum theory and local hidden-variable explanations into measurable experiments. With collaborators he improved photon sources and measurement settings, then studied single photons, laser cooling and ultracold atoms. His work connects quantum foundations with quantum information science and earned a share of the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics with John Clauser and Anton Zeilinger.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Tested quantum theory through entanglement experiments, advancing quantum information, communication and fundamental physics.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Studied at ENS Cachan and Orsay; physics agrégation (1969); Paris-Sud doctorate d'État (1983)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Bell-inequality experiments
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Used entangled photons and changing analyzer settings with his team to test limits of local hidden-variable theories.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: From photons to cold atoms
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Contributed to single-photon tests, laser cooling and quantum simulation with ultracold atoms.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Received into the Académie française
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Delivered his reception speech after election in2025 to René de Obaldia's seat.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Shared Nobel Prize in Physics
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Honored with Clauser and Zeilinger for entangled-photon experiments and contributions to quantum-information science.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Shared Wolf Prize
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Recognized with Clauser and Zeilinger for experiments on quantum foundations.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Established atom-optics group
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Returned to the Institut d'Optique to lead research on ultracold atoms and quantum gases.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Cooling below photon recoil
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Published coherent-population-trapping cooling work with Cohen-Tannoudji and colleagues.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Completed doctorate d'État
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Completed doctoral work on three experimental tests of Bell inequalities with entangled photons.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Time-varying analyzer experiment
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Published a Bell test using time-varying analyzers with Jean Dalibard and Gérard Roger.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Physics agrégation
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Completed the physics agrégation after studies at ENS Cachan and Orsay, then continued optical research.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Agen
